title: BAGMAN XeroAccountAssignment
description: The authoritative, write-once record of which Xero chart-of-accounts entry a piece of evidence was actually coded to (`xero/account-suggestion-producer` WO). Created ONLY by a human operator's resolution of an `XERO_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED` Needs You item — never by the suggestion producer itself (see `bagman.xero_account_suggestion.v1`, a separate, non-authoritative AI proposal record). Exactly one row per `evidence_id` (real database-level unique constraint) — a genuine reassignment attempt (a second call with a DIFFERENT `account_id`) raises a conflict, mirroring `EvidenceItem.assign_entity`'s own write-once discipline exactly; this is a deliberate, not-yet-built correction workflow, same as entity reassignment. This record never itself mutates Xero — it is BAGMAN's own internal record of the human decision, nothing more.

assignment_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this assignment row.

evidence_id.description: The `EvidenceItem` this assignment resolves — exactly one assignment row may ever exist per `evidence_id`.

entity_id.description: The BAGMAN `GovernedEntity` this assignment belongs to — must match the referenced evidence's own authoritative `entity_id` at resolution time (validated by the resolution handler, never trusted from a stale suggestion-time snapshot alone).

tenant_id.description: The Xero organisation/tenant `account_id` below resolves within — same field name/shape as `XeroAccount.tenant_id`/`XeroAccountSuggestion.tenant_id`.

account_id.description: The Xero `AccountID` this evidence was actually coded to — validated, at resolution time, against a FRESH re-fetch of the eligible-account set (never the suggestion-time snapshot, which may be stale).

source.description: `AI_ACCEPTED` — the operator accepted BAGMAN's own suggested `account_id` unchanged. `OPERATOR_SELECTED` — the operator chose a different, valid eligible account instead.

suggestion_id.description: The `XeroAccountSuggestion` that prompted this assignment, when one exists — null is legal (an assignment could in principle be recorded against an `XERO_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED` item with no live suggestion, e.g. a defensive future path), but every resolution this WO builds always supplies one.

assigned_by_actor_type.description: Mirrors `NeedsYouItem.resolved_by_actor_type` — who/what made this coding decision.
